title.narrative: Sierra Leone inter- faith action towards credible, free, fair and non- violence Election- Scale up

description.narrative:
This project is building on the existing project with the Inter-Religious Council Sierra Leone title: Sierra Leone inter- faith action towards credible, free, fair and non- violence Election. At present tensions are very high as both parties (the ruling party-APC and the main opposition- SLPP) are claiming victory ahead of the announcement of the final result by the National Electoral Commission. In the wake of the announcement of 50% results by the National Electoral Commission there has been reported cases of burning of houses in some part of Kailahun and few riots in the east and central parts of Freetown.
As tensions continues to mount the role of religious leaders in engaging key stakeholders across the broader political spectrum and inspiring women including young people to remain peaceful throughout the elections and even after is very key. CAFOD has therefore provided an additional support to extend the project for another six-month period. An additional district has also been added which sum up to seven districts in total.
